transcript.answer: Otto PR #475, "Hand the resolved fallback to HAL Engine, and refuse fallbacks it cannot serve". It closes issue #474 and was merged on 2026-10-23. Before it, `buildEngine` in `apps/api/src/server.ts` passed no `fallbackProviders`, so the fallback from PR #438 (#179) never reached the engine. PR #475 added `supportAgentProviders(config)`, which returns `provider` plus `fallbackProviders`. The latter holds the resolved fallback, or `[]` when `FALLBACK_MODEL_ID` is unset.
